content: Mba Miya Aga Tsa Yesu
Ənggǝra Yesu kuɗǝna na patǝ sǝˈyar kau, kǝ ji na anǝ zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar,
“Hyu sǝni abǝr, lardur nǝ vǝlna a hyiri pida mǝthlǝ ǝnga tsu nju nda sa lǝri Zǝr Ndau aga nja dlakǝya nyi.”
Kǝ pubu dǝdǝgalˈyar ǝnga njira nggurǝm nǝ mǝlmǝ kaɓiya dzǝ patǝ ar pathla nǝ pubu kǝra ndiya ǝnga dǝgalǝu, ndǝra nju ngga ǝnga Kayafasu.
Ndǝ mba miya lagu kǝra nda sǝn uya nda mbar Yesu ari ɗǝɗǝwa aga nda tsǝya nyi.
Ama kǝ ndǝ na, “Aˈyi pǝcir mini kǝ mai, ara ja sara hyaˈana hangǝkala nji.”
Nji Ɓǝsiya Yesu Ənga Mal KisǝuWu Bethlani
Ma tsu Yesu wu Bethlani, wu ki Simanu ndǝra ɗǝɗǝmǝu ndǝr pibi,
kǝ vanyi mala shili ǝnga pǝla mal kisǝu kǝra nju ɗǝl ǝnga gǝnna gangǝ gagaɗau. Mala kǝ shili ji sa pǝnggǝr nyi mala nyi a gyar kǝra ja ar pǝci kǝra nda vǝr sǝm sǝr sǝm.
Ta zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar lari abangau, kǝ huɗa nda ndzau, ndu na anǝ kǝrnda, “Wathlǝmǝ culi najaka wira sa?
Mal kau, nju sǝn ɗǝlna ǝnga gǝnna gangǝu, ba nja dlǝwari nji tǝtǝ dǝnama ǝnga gǝnna nyi.”
Arya Yesu wu sǝnbiya sǝra ndu na, kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “Aga mi nga hyu ɓwanǝ nyi kǝr anǝ mala ka? A mǝliya ɗar ja sǝra mǝnahǝu.
Nji tǝtǝ dǝnama aˈyi nda ǝkkǝˈyi hyi parangǝu, ama nayau aˈyi yi ǝkkǝˈyi hyi parangǝ mai.
Mal kisǝ kǝ ji pǝnggǝr ɗa kau, nǝ pabǝ dzǝ nǝ haɗǝ ɗa ngau.
Yu nar hyi jirkura nyi, kalar vira nju nda tǝtǝlna ndǝshigu kǝ ari wu duniya patǝu, nju nda ndǝr ar kǝra sǝ kǝ ji mǝliya kau, aga ɗǝngari ǝnga ja.”
Yahuda Dlǝwunggǝri AgaJa Thlǝna Hiya Yesu
Kǝ pathlǝu wu pama zǝmbǝlma nyi kumo apǝ mǝthlǝu, kǝra nju ngga ǝnga Yahuda Isikarayoti maˈyi a ndǝgya pubu dǝdǝgalˈyar,
ji nda yiwa nda, “Yiɗawu nga hyu kina ɗa ma yi sǝn lǝr hyi nya?” Kǝ ndǝ jigabiya gǝnna sulayi makǝrkumunyi
Mbari ar pǝci kau, ngǝ Yahuda wu gal lagu kǝra ja sǝn lǝri Yesu ari.
Yesu Sǝm Lardur VǝlnaƏnga Zǝmbǝlma Nyiˈyar
Ar pǝci nǝ tanggǝrma nǝ lardur nǝ macikǝl gǝra thlǝlamǝ, kǝ zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar shili ndǝ sa yiwa nyi, “Əmani nga gu yiwu ˈya pabǝri ngǝ vir sǝm lardur nǝ vǝlna ka?”

Kǝ ji shaɗǝwa, ji na, “Maˈya mau a vu huɗa mǝlmau, hyu vuwa thlǝwa vanyi ndǝ a vuna, ba hya nar nyi, ‘Malǝmǝ ngǝ na, abǝr, pǝci nyi a ɗar lǝhǝu. Ju sa sǝm lardur nǝ vǝlna ǝkkǝˈyi zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar wu ki ngau.’ ”
Kǝ zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar mǝliya ǝnggǝra ji nar nda ta, ba ndǝ pabǝri vir sǝm lardur nǝ vǝlna nyi.
Ənggǝra wagǝ ɗa, Yesu nggya aga ja sǝm sǝr sǝm ǝkkǝˈyi zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar kumo apǝ mǝthlǝu.
Ma tsu nda vǝr sǝm sǝr sǝm, kǝ Yesu na anǝ nda, “Jiri nga yu na anǝ hyi, pathlǝu wu pama hyu nda thlǝna hiya yau.”
Kǝ ɗǝfuwa nda ndzǝ gagaɗau, kalar ndu dzǝgwa na anǝ nyi wu pama nda, “Ənga jiri, nayi ngǝ ya, Thlagǝu?”
Kǝ Yesu shaɗǝwa, “Ndǝ ka a vǝr fǝ tsi wu cala ǝnga yi kau, ngu nda thlǝna hiya yau.
Zǝr Ndau, wu tǝ ǝnggǝra nji tsǝfǝri ar kǝra ja, ama sǝr tǝhuɗǝ anǝ ndǝra wu nda thlǝna hiya Zǝr Ndau. Wu ndiya anǝ ndǝ kau, kuji nji gǝra ya nyi.”
Kǝ Yahuda ndǝra wu nda thlǝna hiya ja na, “Malǝmǝ, ǝnga jiri nayi ngǝ ya?” Yesu shaɗǝwa, ji na, “Angǝ, nagǝ ǝnga kǝrngǝ ma, a nabiyar gau.”
Tsu nda vǝr sǝm sǝr sǝm, kǝ Yesu hǝri macikǝl, kǝ ji lǝr usaku anǝ Hyal, ba ji ɓǝɓǝlǝwa, kǝ ji nǝ nyi anǝ zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar, ju na, “Dlǝwura mau hya sǝm, naja kǝ kumǝr dza yi ngau.”
Kǝ ji hǝri kyakiwa nǝ ˈyimir wur inabi, kǝ ji lǝr usaku anǝ Hyal, kǝ ji nǝr nda, ju na, “Patǝkura hyi, hya sa.
Najakǝ mashi ɗa ngau nǝ nyabiya alkawal mafǝliyangǝ, kǝra nju nda pǝna aga tǝfǝbiya bikǝ nǝ nji patǝu.
Yu nar hyi, tsu yu ɓǝra sa ˈyimir yayar wur inabi mai, kǝl pǝci kǝra yu nda sa mafǝliyangǝ ǝnga hyi wu tǝlkur nǝ Dǝɗa.”
Ayukuɗa ndǝ kuɗǝna thlǝ na, kǝ ndǝ maˈyi a dar Mǝ nǝ wur Zaitunu.
Yesu Nana Ənggǝra BiturusuWu Nda Kǝpalna Sǝni Nyi
Kǝ Yesu na anǝ nda, “Vuˈyi ǝshina kau, patǝ hyi, hyu nda tǝtǝlnakǝr arya sǝra wu nda ɗa ǝnga yau. Ara tsǝtsǝfǝ nga nyi wu lǝkakaɗǝ nǝ Hyal, abǝr,
Ama ayukuɗa yi hyaˈari sara vir tau, yu tǝrabiya wu mwar hyi a vu Galili.”
Əngwar Biturusu anǝ nyi, “Alaga nji patǝ hwinakǝr ndǝ piyari ngau, nayi wu, piyari ngǝ nǝ ɗa mai.”
Kǝ Yesu shaɗǝwa nyi, ji na, “Yu nar ngǝ jirkura nyi Biturusu, ǝshina vuˈyi kau, kadivira vǝgǝmǝ wu nda wau, gu kǝpalna sǝn ɗa ar kǝr ar kǝr makǝru.”
Kǝ Biturusu ɓǝra na, “Alaga nji tsǝya ɗa daɓǝ ǝnga gau, nayi wu kǝpal sǝni ngǝ mai.” Kǝ patǝkura alenyi zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar nana abangǝ tsu.
Yesu Kǝdi Hyal Wu Gyatsimani
Kǝ Yesu ǝkkǝˈyi zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar maˈyi a ndar vanyi vi kǝra nju ngga ǝnga Gyatsimani, kǝ ji nda na anǝ nda, “Nggya mǝ nǝr hyi ǝnggau, yu maˈyi a ndu mwa ya nda kǝdi Hyal.”
Kǝ ji hǝri Biturusu ǝnga wazha Zabadi mǝthlǝ ǝnga ja, nanda ngǝ Yakubu ǝnga Yahwana, naja ǝnga huɗǝ kiyakiyar gagaɗau ǝnga ɓwaɓwatǝ ara sǝra ja a gwa.
Kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “Huɗǝ ndzǝndzǝ kǝra ya gwa a sǝn tsǝya ɗa. Nahyi hya nggya liliˈu hya ɓǝla ǝnga yau.”

Ji ɓar dzǝ kushu, ba ji dla lagu bama a gyiwu ˈyi, ja vǝr ndǝr ǝnga Hyal, ju na, “Tada, ma ja abǝr yiwu ca ngǝ uya, bǝgǝ ga hǝna najaka ɓwaɓwatǝ ar kǝra yau. Alaga abangau, aˈyi sǝra yu yiwu mai, ama sǝra gu yiwu.”
Ba ji sha shili ara zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar, ba ji sa thlǝwa nda wu ghanyi. “Mi nga ma? Aˈyi hyu sǝn nggya nǝ ɓǝla ǝnga yi alaga nǝ saka pathlǝ wa?” Ji yiwa Biturusu.
“Hya nggya ǝnga ɓǝla ǝnga hya kǝdi Hyal ara hya sara tǝɗau a gu dzau. Mambǝl wu yiwu nǝ nyi, ama kumǝr dzǝ a tǝwari.”
Kǝ ji ɓǝra maˈyi nǝ mǝthlǝkura nyi, ji nda ndǝr ǝnga Hyal, ji na, “Tada, Ma aˈyi ɗa tsaˈa aga ɓwaɓwatǝ ka hǝna kǝr mai, ama kǝl yi tǝwari, taˈyi sǝra gu yiwu patǝ ja ɗarkǝr.”
Ənggǝra ji sha shili, kǝ ji ɓǝra thlǝwa nda wu ghanyi, ara ghanyi tǝdǝɓǝu ar liya nda.
Kǝ ji piyari nda, ba ji maˈyi sǝ nyi nǝ makǝrkura nyi, kǝ ji nda ndǝr ǝnga Hyal, ji ɓǝra nana sǝˈyar ta.
Ji ɓǝra sha shili ǝgya zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar, ba ji thlǝwa nda wu ghanyi, kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “Tsu hyu ghanyi ya, hyu ɓǝlsar ya? Tsaˈa abangǝ ja! Pǝci a ɗari nju nǝ nyi Zǝr Ndau a gwu tsa njir bikau.
Hyaˈara mau, mǝna maˈyi! Kǝja ndǝr thlǝ hiya yi ta a shiliri!”
Nji Mbar Yesu
Tsu Yesu a vǝr ndǝr, kǝja Yahuda, pathlǝu wu pama zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar kumo apǝ mǝthlǝu, shili ǝnga nji gangǝu ǝnga katsakǝr ba zǝwa wu tsa nda. Njira pubu dǝdǝgalˈyar ǝnga njira nggurum nǝ mǝlmǝ sǝwa.
Ndǝr thlǝ hiya ja kau, a dǝgar ndar ja mǝtsamǝ, “Ma ndǝra yi bǝrpiya nyi, naja ngau, mbari nya mau.”
Ənggǝra ji dla, ba ji maˈyi tǝwar a ndǝra Yesu, kǝ Yahuda usar nyi, ji na, “Usi Malǝmǝ,” kǝ ji bǝrpiya nyi.
Əngwar Yesu anǝ nyi, “Bazhi ɗa, mǝliya sǝra hǝ nga shili.” Kǝ nja nyi shili ndǝ sa mbari Yesu, kǝ ndǝ sǝɓiya nyi ɓaɓalu.
Ənggǝra ndǝ lari abangau, kǝ pathlǝ wu pama njir ɓǝ Yesu tǝsǝbiya katsakǝr nyi, ba ji thlana himiya mafa pubu kǝra ndiya ǝnga dǝgal ǝni.
Əngwar Yesu anǝ nyi, “Shabiya katsakǝr ngau a vu ki nyi, arya kalar ndǝra tsǝbiya katsakǝr, katsakǝr ngu nda tsa nyi.
Hyu nggani abǝr aˈyi yu sǝn ngga Dǝɗa, ba ja sǝwa ɗa alaga bwata waladiˈyar kumo apǝ mǝthlǝ wa?
Ama lagu mani ngǝ sǝra tsǝtsǝfau wu lǝkakaɗǝ nǝ Hyal wu nyabiya dza, abǝr aˈyi ji ɗa lagu kǝ maya?”

Ar pǝci ta, Yesu na anǝ dlamir nji, “Nayi ngǝ ndǝr tǝɗǝmwa anǝ njir gwaɗǝvi ya, ǝnga hyi sǝbiya katsakǝr ǝnga zǝwa aga hya sa mba ɗa ya? Parangǝu ya vǝr nggya ǝkkǝˈyi hyi wu ki Hyal ya vǝr highiɓau, ama nahyi sayi mbar ɗa mai.
Sǝˈyar kǝ ɗa patǝ aga sǝra nabiˈyar tsǝfǝri a nyabiya dzau.” Kǝ patǝ zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar tǝtǝlna dzau ba ndǝ piyari nyi wu tsa nda.
Yesu Wu Mwar PathlaNǝ Njir Yahudiya
Njira mbari Yesu hǝri nyi a ndǝra Kayafasu dǝgala Pubu, vira malǝmǝ dlaɗǝˈyar ǝnga njira nggurǝm kaɓǝ ari.
Kǝ Biturusu nu nyi wu ndǝl wu ndǝl tsatsalǝu, tsaˈa vwar huɗa ki dǝgala Pubu. Ji vuwa nggya ǝkkǝˈyi njir sǝkǝ ki aga ja lari ǝnggǝra nju ɗa ǝnga ja.
Pubu dǝdǝgalˈyar ǝnga patǝr njir zǝwa a vǝr gal lagu kǝra nda sǝn vazǝya Yesu aga nda tsǝya nyi.
Ama sǝ aˈyi ndǝ uya mai, alaga kǝ nji gangǝu shili ndu thla sakida nǝ fati ar kǝra Yesu. Ayukuɗa nyi patǝu, kǝ alenyi nji mǝthlǝ biyar babal,
ndǝ na, “Sal kǝ na, abǝr, ‘Yu sǝn dlana ki Hyal kau, ba ya ɓǝra hǝriya nyi wu pida makǝru.’ ”
Pubu kǝra ndiya ǝnga dǝgal hyaˈari aˈyi taˈyau, ji na anǝ Yesu, “Mi ngǝ sǝ kǝ nja vǝr na a miya ndǝla gǝ ka? Sǝ aˈyi gu na a gǝri wa?”
Ama kǝ Yesu nggya sǝ nyi ɗiyu. Kǝ pubu kǝra ndiya ǝnga dǝgal na anǝ nyi, “Yi wu daɓǝr ngǝ ǝnga thlǝmǝr Hyal kǝra a dǝmǝlmau, nar ˈya ma nagǝ ngǝ Kǝrsiti, Zǝr Hyal.”

Yesu shaɗǝwa, “Angǝ, abangǝ nga nyi ǝnggǝr kǝra gǝ na kau. Ama taˈyi ya nar hyi patǝ hyi, mbar kabangǝkau, hyu sa lari Zǝr Ndau a vǝr nggya ar tsi mazǝma ndǝ dǝgal dǝnama, a vǝr shida wu dlama sara dǝmǝlmau.”
Kǝ pubu kǝra ndiya ǝnga dǝgal tana lǝgutǝ kǝrnyi ǝnga huɗǝ ndzǝndzau, ju na, “A nanar ja ndǝr nǝ deɓa Hyal! Sakida mi mǝnu ɓǝra gala? Kǝja hya nggari ndǝr diɗa vi nyi ǝnga kǝrhyi.
Mi nga hyu nggana?” “A ɗar tsaˈa nja tsǝya nyi,” ndǝ shaɗǝwa.
Kǝ ndǝ tǝfuwa nyi tuli a vu bama ja, ǝnga alenyi nji tsu dǝdǝguwa nyi tsi. Alenyi nji nǝ nyi tsi balma
ndu dzǝgwa na, “Ma nagǝ ngǝ nabi, nana ˈya, Kǝrsiti, tara wa ngǝ dǝgǝr ngǝ ka?”
Biturusu Kǝpalna Sǝni Yesu
Ar pǝci kǝra Biturusu a vǝr nggya a biyar huɗǝ ki, kǝ kwar ki kǝ shili ǝgya ja, ji sa na anǝ nyi, “Nagǝ ma, nahyi ngǝ shili ǝkkǝˈyi Yesu ndǝr Galili.”
Ji kǝpalna nyi wu mwar nda patǝu, ji na, “Nayi wu sǝni sǝra gu na kǝ mai.”
Ta ji maˈyi a biya miya kiya nyi, ba ji biya ɓǝ ǝnga vanyi kwar ki, kǝ kwa kǝ lar nyi, kǝ ji na anǝ njira tataˈyi a ndǝna, “Ndǝ kǝ ma, nanda ngǝ ǝkkǝˈyi Yesu ndǝr Nazǝratu.”
Ji ɓǝra kǝpalna nyi daɓǝ ǝnga sǝm fǝla, “Yi wu sǝn ndǝ kǝ mai!”
Ɓǝliya sar kushu, njira tataˈyi a ndǝna ndǝ maˈyi a ndǝgya Biturusu, ndǝ nda nar nyi, “Ənga jiri, pathlǝ gu pama nda, arya kiyara gau a nanar ndǝla gau.”
Kǝ ji mbari shiˈwa kǝrnyi, ǝnga ji ɓǝra sǝm fǝla anǝ nda, abǝr, “Yi wu sǝn ndǝ kǝ mai!” Ənggǝrna kǝ vǝgǝmǝ wau.
Ənggau kǝ Biturusu ɗǝngari ndǝr kǝra Yesu nar nyi, abǝr, “Divira vǝgǝmǝ a wau, gu kǝpalna sǝn ɗa ar kǝr ar kǝr makǝru.” Kǝ ji hwi a biya, ji biya tiwi ǝnga sǝlǝm gagaɗau.
